hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed WETH fee on every swap in both directions using return-delta accounting. Each pool has an immutable per-pool fee config (feePips, projectTreasury, protocolTreasury) registered once by a permissioned launcher; accrued WETH is distributed via a permissionless claim() function.
